overall_summary: Sample size is extremely small with low total views (5-20 views per video). Early signals indicate phone-centric relatability (saved contact names, chat history) slightly outperforms general atmospheric quotes.

winning_patterns.pattern: Specific phone screen interactions (saved numbers, empty chats, photos)
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos referencing phone contact name (20 views) and DP/photo (18 views) received the highest view counts in the dataset.
winning_patterns.action: Anchor hooks around relatable digital touchpoints rather than vague abstract thoughts.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic atmospheric setups without immediate personal context
weak_patterns.evidence: Tea cooling down on the table hook garnered only 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid starting videos with generic scenery or tea imagery; lead immediately with direct visual actions or personal phone habits.

next_video.concept: Typing a long honest message in the chat bar and then backspacing it all to send just a short polite reply.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with a screen showing a long draft being deleted letter by letter.
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that the person received a quick 'I'm fine' reply while sitting next to someone else who never knew.
next_video.reason: Mid-afternoon posts (around 13:45 UTC) performed consistently higher in the limited sample set.

experiment: Testing if unsaid emotional text deletion ('जो कहना रह गया') creates higher retention than saved contact hooks.
